control.title: Board-level oversight of IT and cyber risk
control.description: A board committee (or the board itself) oversees IT strategy and cyber risk, meets on a fixed schedule, reviews the cyber risk posture and major incidents, and records its decisions.

evidence_hint: Committee charter, meeting calendar and minutes showing cyber risk items and decisions.
acceptance_criteria: A charter for the board committee overseeing IT and cyber risk
Minutes from the review period show cyber risk discussed and decisions recorded

criteria_coverage.criterion: A charter for the board committee overseeing IT and cyber risk
Minutes from the review period show cyber risk discussed and decisions recorded

requirements.title: Board oversight and IT sub-committee
requirements.guidance: The Board oversees information security and cyber risk; it may delegate to a sub-committee headed by a member with security experience, meeting at least quarterly.

requirements.title: Board-approved information security policy and Annexure 1 baseline
requirements.guidance: Adopt a Board-approved information security policy and the baseline technology recommendations in Annexure 1.

requirements.title: Security risk assessments reported to the Board
requirements.guidance: Assess security risks and present them and audit reports to the Board.
